notes: Three corrections: the presentative dummy 'there' joins the copula-bearing עוֹד unit under rule 20 instead of standing as an `added` unit; the בְּ + קֶרֶב fusion heads on the construct noun under rule 23, matching the chapter's four other preposition-plus-construct fusions; and שְׁנָתַיִם heads on 'years', the word carrying the lemma שָׁנָה, matching the plural שָׁנִים later in the same verse.
